item.text: {"explanation":"The conditional rule is identity-based: enabled options form the navigable sequence; edits preserve active and selected IDs only while those IDs remain enabled and present. Keyboard movement operates on the current enabled sequence, with circular arrows and endpoint jumps. A counterexample is any output that changes the first event's active ID without an input event justifying that change.","mapping":"Map config/options to an ordered option view, active and selected to stable IDs, and each event to a deterministic transition over that view. Reordering changes navigation order but not retained identity.","assumptions":"When no active ID exists, ArrowDown selects the first enabled option and ArrowUp selects the last; Home and End select endpoints. if(e.type==='click'){if(valid(st,e.id))st.a=st.s=e.id}else if(e.type==='key'){var q=enabled(st),i;if(e.key==='Enter'){if(valid(st,st.a))st.s=st.a}else
